method.inputs: Freeze logs once per dataset. Fresh isolated process and empty DB for each variant/pair; identical sources and scenario sequence; alternating AB/BA; one excluded warmup pair.
method.treatment: Only one nonunique persistent index differs. Product source, query SQL, other indexes, schema version and runtime are identical. Same product optimize on both variants.
method.refresh: refreshSummary wall time includes scan, local lock, parsing, aggregation preparation, replaceSessions, commit and product optimize. UI/IPC/account calls excluded. First monthly page is separately timed.
method.transactions: Intercept BEGIN IMMEDIATE through COMMIT return. Sum and max per refresh, BEGIN and COMMIT subtimes, plus replaceSessions transactions only. No competing writer. Reader transactions excluded. Equal instrumentation in both variants.
method.storage: Main file and live/free pages after successful TRUNCATE checkpoint, no VACUUM; dbstat index allocation. WAL sampled before correctness and checkpoint, after first page; auto-checkpoint remains enabled.
method.creation: After final scenario, A creates the index on populated data inside one transaction. DDL+COMMIT timed separately from optimize and checkpoint; before/after file and live/index bytes retained.
method.correctness: Full raw/rollup result comparisons for ten group/provider-model combinations, semantic facts/aggregate hashes, FK and integrity checks per scenario. A/B and across-pair counts and hashes must match; appended token/request deltas asserted.
method.limits: Single machine, warm OS cache, five pairs by default; no cache reset. Transactions are software-observed elapsed times including callback execution. TEMP-only work can be inside a write transaction. Timing hooks add small equal overhead. Private bodies, names, session IDs and source paths omitted.
